page.notes: The scan shows a light show-through of the neighbouring page along the right edge; it is not transcribed. The marginal notes "M.D.XLIX." appear as printed "M.D.XL / IX." and are given as one line. The left margin note beside the first paragraph reads "Florentius postremus supplicio affectus." and is placed at the start of the paragraph "Is tandem", which continues from the previous paragraph (the text before it runs to the full measure). The Stephanus note is placed beside "cum Stephano". The page ends at a hyphenated line; the catchword "ium" completes the word on the next page. No page number is printed.
